<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="th">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>TaraCGM48Fanweb</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Prompt:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#fff7fa; --card:#ffffff; --ink:#4a2c3a; --muted:#a07a8c;
  --pink:#ff7eb3; --pink-d:#e0518a; --pink-l:#ffe0ee; --line:#ffd1e3;
  box-sizing:border-box;
  padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
    --bg:#2a1620; --card:#3a1f2c; --ink:#ffeaf3; --muted:#d9a8bf;
    --pink:#ff8fbd; --pink-d:#ff6aa5; --pink-l:#512c3e; --line:#6a3a50;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#2a1620; --card:#3a1f2c; --ink:#ffeaf3; --muted:#d9a8bf;
  --pink:#ff8fbd; --pink-d:#ff6aa5; --pink-l:#512c3e; --line:#6a3a50;
}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);scroll-behavior:smooth}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:'Prompt',system-ui,sans-serif;line-height:1.7}
.wrap{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px 48px}
.hero{text-align:center;padding:44px 18px 36px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--pink-l),var(--bg) 70%);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.avatar{width:168px;height:168px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 14px;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:56px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink),var(--pink-d));box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(224,81,138,.3);border:5px solid var(--card);overflow:hidden}
.avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:40% 30%;display:block}
.hero h1{margin:0;font-size:2rem;color:var(--pink-d);letter-spacing:.5px}
.hero p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted)}
.chips{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.chip{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--pink-d);border-radius:999px;padding:3px 14px;font-size:.85rem}
section{margin-top:28px}
h2{font-size:1.2rem;margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--pink-d);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
h2::after{content:"";flex:1;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--line),transparent)}
.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:6px 18px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(255,126,179,.1)}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
.row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.row b{color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;flex:0 0 38%}
.row span{text-align:right;flex:1}
.age{font-weight:600;color:var(--pink-d)}
.tbd{color:var(--muted);font-style:italic}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:14px 0}
.tag{background:var(--pink-l);color:var(--pink-d);border-radius:999px;padding:4px 14px;font-size:.92rem}
.work{padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line)}
.work:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.work small{color:var(--muted);display:block}
.links{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px;padding:14px 0}
.link{display:block;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;padding:10px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink),var(--pink-d));color:#fff;font-weight:500}
.link.off{background:var(--pink-l);color:var(--muted);pointer-events:none;font-weight:400}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:.8rem;margin-top:36px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<header class="hero">
  <div class="avatar" id="avatar"><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,
